title: Repository editor: discard confirmations, Agent preparation and diff pages
goal: Explain bounded nested repository editor controls while distinguishing local discard, file reads, unsent prompt preparation and display-only pagination from writes, model sending and native cancellation.
prerequisites: Internal source-only authoring record, customer ineligible; active mounted Repositories workspace with current checkout ownership and a loaded file where applicable.
Discard confirmation applies to a buffer different from its loaded/saved baseline. Preserve wanted draft text before confirming. Checkout acquisition is outside this article.

Ask Agent needs an onAskAgent callback, current owner, loaded file/editor reference, no busy operation and 1–8,000 selected JavaScript string units from an accepted relative path. Path screening rejects known sensitive paths; it does not scan selected content. Review secrets and private data yourself.
Agent consumption waits for an active available conversation without loading, sending, pending proposal or decision; sign-in/workspace and selection validation remain required.
permissions: These documentation identifiers are proposals, not installed help bindings or registered runtime controls.
Preparing code creates an unsent prompt; later Send shares the prompt with the approved provider and remains a separate decision. No code execution or target authority is granted.
Cancel dismisses a pending callback; it does not cancel submitted native reads/writes or undo a prior Save.

steps.instruction: Select a file row with unsaved edits, including the same dirty file. Review Discard unsaved changes? Choose Cancel to retain the editor, or deliberately choose Discard and open after preserving wanted text.
steps.expectedState: Confirmation calls openFile(path), clearing loaded file, history, selection and buffer before read_repository_file. A successful current read loads a new baseline; failure can leave an empty editor and error. No disk write or persistent draft stash is created.

steps.instruction: Choose a different checkout while dirty. Review Switch repositories? Choose Cancel or deliberately Discard and switch. Selecting the already selected checkout returns without a dialog; clean-buffer selection proceeds without discard confirmation.
steps.expectedState: Switching changes checkout ownership/generation and clears file, history, status, checks, errors/notices and confirmation state, then follows existing selection/loading effects. It does not save, commit or perform a remote operation.

steps.instruction: Before confirmation, use Cancel, backdrop mouse-down or Escape while this pane is active to dismiss the shared inline dialog. Mouse-down inside the alertdialog stops propagation.
steps.expectedState: The pending callback is not invoked. Cancel has autoFocus and source markup includes alertdialog, aria-modal and title association; native focus trapping/restoration and keyboard/accessibility acceptance are unverified. Confirm clears the dialog before awaiting its callback; no post-confirm Cancel or pending-state button is defined here.

steps.instruction: Select eligible code and choose Ask Agent / Ask Agent about selection. Review Prepare selected code for Agent? and its descriptive text. Cancel if different text is wanted; the dialog does not preview the excerpt.
steps.expectedState: The file object, full buffer snapshot and excerpt are captured. Moving the selection alone does not change the captured excerpt. Cancel, backdrop and active-pane Escape prepare nothing.

steps.instruction: Choose Prepare Agent draft only after reviewing the selection. Review the entire resulting Agent composer, including existing text.
steps.expectedState: Preparation rechecks no busy operation, the identical loaded file object and unchanged buffer; otherwise The file changed while reviewing this selection. Select and review it again. Obsolete ownership may suppress the callback. App stores selection/current context/workspace and navigates to Agent. Ordinary code selects Inspect / Code Review and chat mode, appending the generated prompt with a blank line if input already exists. It neither replaces existing input nor invokes Send, saves files or executes code.

steps.instruction: Open Review changes / Review local changes for the current file.
steps.expectedState: Local unsaved file diff compares savedContent with current content, the last loaded/saved baseline rather than HEAD or the whole repository. With no additions/removals it shows No unsaved content changes. Agent proposal FileDiff reuse does not change this baseline.

steps.instruction: When rendered diff rows exceed 2,000, use Previous / Previous diff page and Next / Next diff page to inspect every page. Close review with its existing toggle.
steps.expectedState: Pages contain at most 2,000 rendered rows including context and omitted-line markers, not 2,000 file lines or bytes. Previous is disabled on page one; Next on the last page. Status states page count and asks review of every page. Changed before/after resets to page one. Paging and closing do not save, approve, undo, request network work or cancel operations; no pagination Cancel exists and Save does not require proof that all pages were visited.

expectedOutcome: An internal reviewer can distinguish discard/read effects, unsent Agent preparation and display-only diff paging, preserving uncertain write outcomes for reconciliation.
limitations: Draft/internal/source-only: null genuine editorial review, no media, native demonstration, visual/keyboard/accessibility acceptance, release mapping, publication or approved retrieval. This is bounded source authoring, not full B4/B5 completion.

The preserved guide/manifest retain e5737ed6ddf26aea8536aed8549121cca80260dd historical context. This record binds actual file bytes at local-source-preview:04bd66b826d52cdc5ed18c7309fc9d3f612accde; no shipped-version or source-currentness claim follows.

Owner checks require mounted state, desktop config/context revision and checkout generation before a captured callback. They may suppress obsolete callbacks but cannot restore discarded buffers or prove native work stopped.

The diff keeps nearby context and … unchanged lines … markers; above 300,000 old/new line pairs it uses coarse common-prefix/suffix comparison. Pagination does not guarantee a minimal edit sequence or a review receipt.

Schema/hash integrity proves source identity, not semantic accuracy, live access, customer eligibility or executed retrieval. No runtime, retrieval catalog, ingestion, UI binding or authority behavior is created.
recovery: After read failure, inspect checkout/path and correct the read problem before deliberately reopening. Discarded text has no persistent recovery here.

An uncertain prior Save requires inspecting current disk content before retrying. Discard/switch does not prove rollback; dismissing a prompt or changing UI ownership after submission is not native cancellation.

If Agent preparation fails or no draft appears after ownership/context change, prepare again from the current file/context; do not assume the old selection survived. Cancel and reselect to use a different excerpt.
If edits change the diff, review again from page one before deliberate Save. Closing review does not undo edits.
